lean.statement:
{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x a : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖a‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x a) a ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x a) a ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖a‖^2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let J := Measure.map (fun p : E × E => (p.1, p.1 + Real.sqrt η • p.2))
      (μ.prod (stdGaussian E))
    ∃ R S : Kernel E E, IsMarkovKernel R ∧ IsMarkovKernel S ∧
      (J.map Prod.swap).IsCondKernel R ∧
      (∀ y, S y = (R y).map (fun x => (2 : ℝ) • x - y)) ∧
      (∀ y, S y = (volume : Measure E).tilted
        (fun u => -V ((1/2 : ℝ) • (y+u)) - ‖y-u‖^2/(8*η))) ∧
      ∀ (f : E → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → HasCompactSupport f →
        ∀ y, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => ∫ u, f u ∂S z) y ∧
          ‖gradient (fun z => ∫ u, f u ∂S z) y‖^2 ≤
            (1/η-(α : ℝ))^2/(4*((α : ℝ)+1/η)) *
              AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.Poincare.variance
                (S y) f
approved_definition_context: E is any finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its norm and Borel measurable structure, including rank zero.

V is globally twice continuously real Frechet differentiable. Evaluated second derivative is its genuine Hessian; alpha and beta are nonnegative reals with 0<alpha<=beta. For every x,a, alpha norm(a)^2<=D²V(x)[a,a]<=beta norm(a)^2.
eta is a positive real with beta*eta<=1. volume is canonical volume. Measure.tilted normalizes the exponential of the displayed function.
stdGaussian E is the canonical centered identity-covariance Gaussian. J is the literal pushforward of mu product Gaussian by (x,g)->(x,x+sqrt(eta)g).

Kernel E E is a measurable probability-transition kernel; IsMarkovKernel asserts every fiber is a probability. IsCondKernel for swapped J asserts the actual regular conditional disintegration. R and S are produced, not supplied; every-y reflection and explicit normalized S density are outputs.
Tests f are real-valued globally smooth (ContDiff order infinity) with compact support; expectations are literal Bochner integrals against S(z). Actual DifferentiableAt is an output at every y.

gradient is the Riesz inverse of the genuine real Frechet derivative; the theorem separately proves differentiability so the bound cannot be a fake totalization. Poincare.variance(S y)f is the actual integral of (f(u)-integral f dS y)^2.

The squared norm of that gradient is bounded by exactly (1/eta-alpha)^2/[4(alpha+1/eta)] times that actual variance. No covariance/domain/Poincare/desired-bound certificate appears among public assumptions.
